m.d: To move something to the side to allow entrance.
m.e: I will open the door for our guests.

m.d: To prepare for business.
m.e: She opened the store.

m.d: Having a hole or opening, not closed.
m.e: The door was open.

m.d: Available for business.
m.e: The shop is open.

m.d: Available for the public to see and change (of code).
m.e: This software has open code because it was released under an open-source license.

m.d: An opportunity is a time, place, or situation in which something can happen, usually something good.
m.e: Sleep provides an opportunity for the body to repair itself.

m.d: An operation is a medical process, often opening the human body.
m.e: The doctors performed the operation in three hours.

m.d: An operation is an action of a group of people working for a goal (often military).
m.e: The Army operation was a success.

m.d: An operation is part or all of a business. (often plural)
m.e: The company's East Coast operation was bigger than its West Coast operation.

m.d: An opinion is a personal idea, a person’s thoughts on a topic.
m.e: You gave your opinion of the case.

m.d: An opening is a place that someone or something can go through.
An opening is the first time a placed is opened to other people.
m.e: We are going to the museum's opening.

m.d: The opposite of something is something else of the same kind but completely different.
m.e: My kids always do the exact opposite of what I tell them.

m.d: If two things are opposite, they are the same kind but completely different from each other.
m.e: "Go left. No, right!" "Do you want me to go left or right? I mean, they're opposite directions, aren't they?"

m.d: If A is opposite B, they are facing each other.
m.e: The bank is just opposite this hotel, right across the street there.

m.d: An option is a choice.
m.e: He has the option to go to university or join the army.

m.d: An opera is a story told by actors singing instead of speaking, along with an orchestra.
m.e: The couple dressed up to go hear their favorite opera at the theatre.

m.d: If you operate a machine, you control it.
m.e: Everyone on board is able to operate the ship.

m.d: If a machine operates, it works.
m.e: Does the device operate independently or does it need to connect to other devices?

m.d: If organizations or people operate, they work or do business.
m.e: The business will continue to operate under the same name.

m.d: An operator is a person who operates something.
m.e: Jo is the operator of the tractor.

m.d: An operator is a person who works on making connections for people over the telephone.
m.e: The operator was struggling to keep the line connected.

m.d: An operator is a symbol that is used to perform a specific operation (addition, subtraction, multiplication or division) in maths.
An opponent is someone who is not in your team in a game, an opposite team.
Someone that objects to something.
m.e: The United Nations is an opponent of the possession of child pornography.

m.d: Opposition to something, is an action or hope to stop it.
m.e: There was strong opposition to the change from parents.

m.d: The opposition is the person or group that you are competing against.
m.e: There was a series of meetings between the leaders of the Government and the opposition parties.

m.d: If you do something openly, you do it without hiding.
"Original Post" or "Original Poster".
Short for operation. Often used in the military.
m.e: The op did not go as they had planned and many solders died.

m.d: To make someone an operator.
m.e: He was popular on the Internet channel and someone would op him as soon as he entered.

m.d: A person who is optimistic expects the best in all possible ways.
m.e: He is very optimistic about his plans that they will succeed.

m.d: If something is operational, it works and is ready to be used.
If something is operational, it is effective.
If you oppose something, you try to stop it or fight against it.
m.e: We would strongly oppose any changes.

m.d: An operative is an employee with some particular function or skill.
An operative is a spy, secret agent, or detective.
If something is operative, it is able to work.
Opium is a yellow-brown, addictive drug.
m.e: China used to sell lots of opium which resulted in many deaths.

m.d: Anything that numbs.
An opener is a tool for opening a container.
An act of oppressing someone or something.
Optimism is the tendency to expect the best or a favourable outcome.
If something is optical, it is related to sight, optics or visible light.
An optimist is someone who always believes that happy things will happen.
Something that is related to the eye or to vision.
If something is optional, you may choose it or not.
m.e: At this event, dress is optional.

m.d: If a person is oppressive, they practice harsh treatment on something they govern.
An opus is a large and important work of art, especially a piece of music or literature.
m.e: Beethoven's final symphony is considered his greatest opus.

m.d: In music, an opus is a numbered composition to show the order in which the works were created.
m.e: Chopin’s Opus 35 includes the famous Funeral March.

m.d: To oppress is to stifle or prevent something.
To oppress is to deny someone's freedom.
